test_vector_evaluation.description: Graduated-pathway distrusted CAs used as positive test vectors. Non-graduated (immediate/triggered/negotiated) used as negative vectors. B >= threshold is the non-remediation flag.
test_vector_evaluation.note: False positives (Symantec, e-Tugra) are argued to be correct structural identifications — both had genuine non-remediation patterns; their pathways differed due to external factors. See paper for full discussion.
